multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: all 24 journey slices are integrated in every stage

checks.proves: Field source satisfies the repository mobile-source policy.
checks.doesNotProve: Lint does not prove usability or accessibility.
checks.failCriteria: Any lint or source-policy error fails.

checks.proves: Runtime contracts, navigation, and configured mobile invariants pass their repository tests.
checks.doesNotProve: Tests may not exercise physical devices.
checks.passCriteria: Command exits zero with deep-link and state coverage present.
checks.failCriteria: Any failure or absent required scenario fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: run RTL, large text, TalkBack, VoiceOver, keyboard/focus, contrast, and target-size matrix across all mapped screens
checks.proves: The actual UI is perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust across platforms.
checks.doesNotProve: Automated scans cannot replace this manual evidence.
checks.passCriteria: Every mapped control is reachable, named, ordered, and actionable.
checks.failCriteria: Any unnamed, unreachable, obscured, clipped, or misleading control fails.
